data.summary: Dynamic and results-driven financial services professional with strong analytical skills and deep interest in capital markets, private markets, valuations, and corporate finance. Highly experienced in end-to-end trade lifecycle management across Fund Administration and Middle Office Operations, specializing in trade capture, enrichment, confirmations, reconciliations, SWIFT instructions, and break resolution. Skilled in NAV calculation, ETDs, OTC Derivatives, CCPs (CCS, TRS, CDS), and proficient in process optimization, controls, and automation.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE
Dynamic and results-driven financial services professional with strong analytical skills and deep interest in capital markets, private markets, valuations, and corporate finance. Highly experienced in end-to-end trade lifecycle management across Fund Administration and Middle Office Operations, specializing in trade capture, enrichment, confirmations, reconciliations, SWIFT instructions, and break resolution. Skilled in NAV calculation, ETDs, OTC Derivatives, CCPs (CCS, TRS, CDS), and proficient in process optimization, controls, and automation.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Northern Trust - Middle Office Trade Confirmations and Settlements Operations • Senior Financial Analyst
Bengaluru, KA Jan 2025 – Present
Experienced in NAV calculation and Fund Accounting, ensuring accurate valuation of portfolios by reconciling trades, cash flows, corporate actions, and market prices
Managed trade capture, enrichment, and confirmations for Ultra High-Net-Worth clients and Buy-Side firms, ensuring seamless T+0 pre-matching and settlement.
Acted as primary escalation point for Front Office desks, resolving trade breaks, mismatches, and urgent discrepancies to minimize settlement failures.
Executed bulk uploads, pre-upload validations, and STP break investigations (security setup gaps, SSI errors), improving STP efficiency.
Confirmed complex instruments (Reverse Repos, Bonds, Equities, CDs, CPs, Swaps) using CTM, Finastra, Fund Connect, and internal booking platforms.
Applied business day conventions and day-count methodologies for accurate cash flow projections. • Designed exception-based controls, reconciliation workflows (TLM, Duco), and automated checklists to reduce manual errors.
Prepared MIS reports, KPIs, and defect logs to monitor trade processing performance.
Northern Trust - Middle Office Trade Confirmations and Settlements Operations • Financial Analyst
Pune, MH
Jul 2022 – Dec 2024
Oversaw end-to-end trade lifecycle processing across Bonds, CDs, CPs, Equities, FX, Derivatives, and Money Market instruments.
Work on trade flow - Trade enrichment, Trade capture, Trade confirmation, and executing SWIFT instructions. • Reconciled Front Office blotters against downstream systems to prevent settlement failures and reconciliation breaks.
Served as SME for process migrations and transitions, ensuring SLA compliance and operational continuity. • Coordinated time-critical settlements with traders, brokers, custodians, and fund accounting teams. • Maintained static data accuracy, SSI validation, and counterparty setup for clean downstream STP. • Executed SWIFT messages (MT541, MT543, MT599) and processed high-value payments within strict cut- offs.
Demonstrated expertise in global custody and settlement systems (DTC, FED, Euroclear, Clearstream, CREST).
Prioritized trades based on value, currency sensitivity, and market risk, reducing fail exposure.
Riansh Corporate Private Limited • Finance Intern
Aurangabad, MH Apr 2021– Jan 2022
Devised pricing strategies & subscription plans of the handicraft products • Assisted in the construction of financial models evaluating corporate performance and investment alternatives through strategic and financial analysis.
Girl Up Vriddhi (NGO at United Nations Program) • Vice-President and Project Manager
Pune, MH Feb 2020- Jan 2022
Organized workshops in universities, underprivileged schools, online awareness drives on taboo topics like menstrual hygiene, racial discrimination, good touch-bad touch etc.
Lead a Fundraising campaign and raised a donation of INR 26,000 worth sanitary kits to women of Dharavi during Covid-19 Lockdown.
